content: {"summary":"Customers frequently report delivery errors, such as missing items or incorrect orders, and feel penalized for correcting them, citing refunds but extra delivery fees [#tk_2609400]. Many complain about drivers refusing to deliver or taking excessive time, leading to frustration and a perception that the service is unreliable [#tk_1157047]. Issues with promo codes, scheduling, and customer support responses further erode trust, with users describing the experience as “dreadful” and “terrible” [#tk_652704, #tk_653515]."}
